headline: A $3.9 million price tag for repairing the County Social Services office in Seaside forces its closure.
summary: The Department of Social Services Office in Seaside where Monterey County residents often apply for vital services like Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKS will close Oct. 30 after a June 2025 audit found it was out of compliance with…
